response.query: What exact ablation matrix (qubit counts, circuit depths, shared vs independent gates, attention on/off, variogram-loss weights) will we pre-register, and which multiple-comparison correction and uncertainty model will be used to claim evidence of quantum advantage?
response.answer: We will pre-register a 5-qubit circuit with 100 layers, shared gates, attention on, and variogram-loss weights. We will use Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons and a Bayesian uncertainty model to claim evidence of quantum advantage.
